60854e25-c406-4cc4-8bea-f7c36bc989a7.title: 鎌倉の海 Kamakura Sea (Stranger)
60854e25-c406-4cc4-8bea-f7c36bc989a7.tags: 1980s synth-pop / deep house; low smoky male baritone in cool, detached call-and-response with backing voices; sparse, moody, roomy, unprocessed mix; deep thumping drum-machine kick, hypnotic pulsing analog-sequencer bassline, cold glassy synth stabs; mysterious, seductive 120 BPM driving workout groove.
60854e25-c406-4cc4-8bea-f7c36bc989a7.lyrics:
[Intro]
(波の音)
Sensei... Sensei...
私はその人を 常に先生と呼んでいた

[Verse 1]
夏の鎌倉 人ごみの浜
掛茶屋の陰 白い浴衣
ひとり静かに 海へ向かう
その背中から 目が離せない

[Pre-Chorus]
沖へ 沖へ 遠く泳ぐ
光る水面 追いかけてく

[Chorus]
Follow you into the sea
先生 振り向いて
Follow you into the sea
自由と歓喜 この胸に

[Verse 2]
落ちた眼鏡を 拾ったあの日
どこかで見た顔 そんな気がした
青い海に 浮かぶものは
私と先生 ふたりだけ

[Pre-Chorus]
沖へ 沖へ 遠く泳ぐ
光る水面 追いかけてく

[Chorus]
Follow you into the sea
先生 振り向いて
Follow you into the sea
自由と歓喜 この胸に

[Bridge]
Easy, breathe, keep the wheel turning
ゆっくり ゆっくり 波に合わせ
Easy, breathe, keep the wheel turning
空と海しか 見えない朝

[Final Chorus]
Follow you into the sea
先生 振り向いて
Follow you into the sea
自由と歓喜 この胸に
Follow you, follow you
どこまでも

[Outro]
私はその人を 先生と呼んでいた
Sensei... Sensei...
(波の音)

f62249a8-49ca-4183-9294-5daf5338ae1f.title: 雑司ヶ谷 Zoshigaya
f62249a8-49ca-4183-9294-5daf5338ae1f.tags: Synth-pop, deep house with a melancholic autumn piano motif, deep thumping drum-machine kick, hypnotic pulsing analog sequencer bass, cold glassy synth stabs; cool plate reverb tails; low smoky male baritone, cool detached phrasing with powerful full-voice belts and layered octave doubles; steady driving 124 BPM groove.
f62249a8-49ca-4183-9294-5daf5338ae1f.lyrics:
[Intro]
Lonely man, lonely road
月に一度の 雑司ヶ谷

[Verse 1]
銀杏の葉が 黄色く降る
墓地の小道を 歩く人
誰の墓かは 言わないまま
花を手向けて 黙って立つ

[Pre-Chorus]
近づくほど 遠くなる
その目の奥 冷たい影

[Chorus]
Lonely man, lonely road
私は淋しい人間です
Lonely man, lonely road
あなたも淋しい人じゃないですか

[Verse 2]
「恋は罪悪ですよ」と 笑わず言う
「しかも神聖なものですよ」と
意味もわからず ペダル踏む
答えはまだ 坂の向こう

[Pre-Chorus]
近づくほど 遠くなる
その目の奥 冷たい影

[Chorus]
Lonely man, lonely road
私は淋しい人間です
Lonely man, lonely road
あなたも淋しい人じゃないですか

[Bridge]
Love is a sin (罪悪)
Love is divine (神聖)
Love is a sin (罪悪)
Keep it steady, keep the line

[Final Chorus]
Lonely man, lonely road
私は淋しい人間です
Lonely man, lonely road
あなたも淋しい人じゃないですか
Lonely road... 雑司ヶ谷

[Outro]
銀杏の道 また来月
Lonely man, lonely road

6f08e3c2-91aa-40b7-84be-c2733e3ad7ba.title: 向上心 Spirit of Ascent
6f08e3c2-91aa-40b7-84be-c2733e3ad7ba.tags: Hard techno house and 1980s synth-pop, led by a hypnotic pulsing analog sequencer bassline, deep thumping drum-machine kick and cold metallic synth stabs; 128 BPM driving workout pulse with tense risers and heavy drops; low gritty male baritone, cool restrained delivery, stacked roomy unprocessed hook harmonies and shouted gang chants; minor-key understated production.
6f08e3c2-91aa-40b7-84be-c2733e3ad7ba.lyrics:
[Intro]
Rise! Rise!
精神的に 向上心のない者は
Rise! Rise!

[Verse 1]
房州の道 波は荒く
K は言った 迷いもなく
道のためなら 全てを捨てろ
恋も欲も 振り切って

[Pre-Chorus]
もっと上へ もっと上へ
心臓を 叩き起こせ
3, 2, 1...

[Drop]
馬鹿だ! (Rise!)
向上心! (Rise!)
精神的に 向上心のない者は 馬鹿だ!
No ambition, no soul!

[Verse 2]
同じ言葉を 投げ返した
小石川の 夜の道
K の足が ふいに止まる
「覚悟、覚悟ならない事もない」

[Pre-Chorus]
もっと上へ もっと上へ
心臓を 叩き起こせ
3, 2, 1...

[Drop]
馬鹿だ! (Rise!)
向上心! (Rise!)
精神的に 向上心のない者は 馬鹿だ!
No ambition, no soul!

[Bridge]
覚悟 覚悟
Breathe in, breathe out
覚悟 覚悟
それは誰の 覚悟なのか
Hold it... hold it...
3, 2, 1...

[Drop]
馬鹿だ! (Rise!)
向上心! (Rise!)
精神的に 向上心のない者は 馬鹿だ!
No ambition, no soul!
No ambition, no soul!

[Outro]
覚悟ならない事もない
Rise...

00ee16fc-e83b-4d5a-8046-3aa89544b424.title: 黒い光 Black Light
00ee16fc-e83b-4d5a-8046-3aa89544b424.tags: 1980s synth-pop, cinematic melodic techno; Japanese-English low male baritone, detached crooning legato, dry and up-front; restrained mix, no glossy lift; 126 BPM half-time climb; pounding drum machine, distorted sub bass, analog sequencer, cold eerie synths, low male choir.
00ee16fc-e83b-4d5a-8046-3aa89544b424.lyrics:
[Intro]
(風の音)
襖が 二尺ほど 開いていた
Too late...

[Verse 1]
冬の夜更け 冷たい風
枕元の ランプが揺れる
呼んでも K は 答えない
襖の向こう 赤い影

[Pre-Chorus]
もう取り返しが 付かない
黒い光が 未来を貫く

[Chorus]
Too late, too late
取り返しが 付かない
Too late, too late
この罪を 背負って登れ

[Verse 2]
遺された 短い手紙
「もっと早く 死ぬべきだのに
何故今まで 生きていたのだろう」
私の名前は どこにもない

[Pre-Chorus]
もう取り返しが 付かない
黒い光が 未来を貫く

[Chorus]
Too late, too late
取り返しが 付かない
Too late, too late
この罪を 背負って登れ

[Bridge]
お嬢さんには 何も言えず
奥さんには 頭を下げて
重い 重い 重い
Stand up and carry it
重い 重い 重い
一歩ずつ 罪を踏め

[Final Chorus]
Too late, too late
取り返しが 付かない
Too late, too late
この罪を 背負って登れ
Too late... too late...

[Outro]
黒い光が 私の未来を貫いて
(風の音)

06d19f19-6572-45ca-b5eb-c455cbb49621.title: 明治の精神 Spirit of Meiji
06d19f19-6572-45ca-b5eb-c455cbb49621.tags: 1980s synth-pop, electro techno; dry, cold production with restrained dynamics and no glossy pop lift; low gritty baritone in intense detached call-and-response with backing voices, hooks doubled; relentless 136 BPM sprint groove; hard-thumping drum-machine kick, fast pulsing analog sequencer bassline, distorted cold synth stabs, taiko hits and cannon-boom impacts.
06d19f19-6572-45ca-b5eb-c455cbb49621.lyrics:
[Intro]
Run 'til the era ends!
明治が 終わる
Run! Run! Run!

[Verse 1]
夏の盛りに 天皇崩御
明治の精神は 天皇に始まって
天皇に終わった 時代が沈む
取り残された 私たちは

[Pre-Chorus]
号砲が 鳴る (Boom!)
号砲が 鳴る (Boom!)
全部 出し切れ

[Chorus]
Run 'til the era ends!
明治の精神に 殉死する
Run 'til the era ends!
最後の一漕ぎ 振り絞れ

[Verse 2]
乃木大将の 知らせが届く
三十五年 待ち続けた
死ぬべき時を 探していた
私も同じ 影の中

[Pre-Chorus]
号砲が 鳴る (Boom!)
号砲が 鳴る (Boom!)
全部 出し切れ

[Chorus]
Run 'til the era ends!
明治の精神に 殉死する
Run 'til the era ends!
最後の一漕ぎ 振り絞れ

[Bridge]
Meiji! Meiji!
時代と 共に
Meiji! Meiji!
Go! Go! Go!

[Final Chorus]
Run 'til the era ends!
明治の精神に 殉死する
Run 'til the era ends!
最後の一漕ぎ 振り絞れ
Run! Run! Run!

[Outro]
明治が 終わった
(Boom...)

fc7fd801-61c6-4853-a455-a85250b70e84.title: 遺書 The Testament
fc7fd801-61c6-4853-a455-a85250b70e84.tags: 1980s synth-pop / deep house, 104 BPM slow cool-down groove; dark plate vocal reverb, cold misty pads and restrained minor-key piano; hushed close-mic low intimate baritone with layered octave doubles and calm detached delivery; soft thumping drum machine, slow pulsing analog bassline, sparse piano, gently resolving minor harmony, understated chorus with no big lift.
fc7fd801-61c6-4853-a455-a85250b70e84.lyrics:
[Intro]
(ピアノ)
Keep it in your heart...
あなたへ 最後の手紙

[Verse 1]
私の過去を あなたに書く
善いことも 悪いことも
誰にも話さず 生きてきた
今 ひとりにだけ 打ち明ける

[Pre-Chorus]
自分の心臓を 破って
その血を あなたの顔に

[Chorus]
Keep it in your heart
新しい命が 宿るなら
Keep it in your heart
それで私は 満足です

[Verse 2]
妻には 何も 知らせたくない
あの人の記憶を 純白のまま
すべてを 腹の中に
しまって置いて 下さい

[Pre-Chorus]
自分の心臓を 破って
その血を あなたの顔に

[Chorus]
Keep it in your heart
新しい命が 宿るなら
Keep it in your heart
それで私は 満足です

[Bridge]
Keep her memory white
純白のまま
Breathe slow, let it go
こころ 静かに

[Final Chorus]
Keep it in your heart
新しい命が 宿るなら
Keep it in your heart
それで私は 満足です

[Outro]
私は その人を 先生と呼んでいた
こころ... こころ...
(ピアノ)

11349519-f681-41a0-bc01-5bf6c0a39dba.title: Ghost on the Battlements
11349519-f681-41a0-bc01-5bf6c0a39dba.tags: Dark progressive trance with rolling sub bass and four-on-the-floor kick; dark filtered delays, sparse deep-minimal mix; steady 124 BPM pulse; low male spoken-chants in clipped staccato phrases, layered gang shouts on the hook, multilingual in English, Japanese, Korean, and French.
11349519-f681-41a0-bc01-5bf6c0a39dba.lyrics:
[Intro - whispered, low male voice]
Remember me... remember me...
私を忘れるな... 나를 기억해...

[Verse - spoken]
Ghost on the wall, cold wind, midnight bell
亡霊が呼ぶ 城壁の上
유령이 말한다 나를 기억해

[Instrumental build]

[Drop]

[Chant]
Remember me (remember me)
忘れるな (忘れるな)
기억해 (기억해)

[Instrumental break - rolling bass]

[Whispered]
Adieu, adieu, remember me
さらば、さらば
안녕, 안녕, 기억해

[Chant]
Remember me (remember me)
忘れるな (忘れるな)
기억해 (기억해)

[Outro - fade]

439a312c-d239-4ce4-9d64-f329ff120a95.title: To Be or Not To Be 生きるべきか 사느냐 죽느냐
439a312c-d239-4ce4-9d64-f329ff120a95.tags: Dark progressive trance with saturated analog synths; low male whispered, spoken, and chanted vocals in call-and-response, soft harmony pads under the chant; rolling sub bass, sparse four-on-the-floor kick, deep hypnotic 132 BPM pulse.
439a312c-d239-4ce4-9d64-f329ff120a95.lyrics:
[Intro - whispered, low male voice]
Live or die... live or die...
生きるべきか... 사느냐 죽느냐...

[Verse - spoken]
One question in the dark, one question
闇の中の問い
어둠 속의 질문

[Instrumental build]

[Drop]

[Chant]
Live or die (live or die)
生きるべきか (生きるべきか)
사느냐 죽느냐 (사느냐 죽느냐)

[Instrumental break - rolling bass]

[Whispered]
Sleep and dream, sleep and dream
眠る、夢を見る
잠들고, 꿈꾸고

[Chant]
Live or die (live or die)
生きるべきか (生きるべきか)
사느냐 죽느냐 (사느냐 죽느냐)

[Outro - fade]

cc668fda-cd96-4aa3-8990-45814a0f037c.title: The Mousetrap ねずみ取り 쥐덫
cc668fda-cd96-4aa3-8990-45814a0f037c.tags: Deep hypnotic trance, dark progressive trance; low male English, Japanese, Korean spoken/chanted vocals with crooning legato phrasing; sparse metallic percussion and soft harmony pads beneath the chorus; 136 BPM four-on-the-floor with rolling sub bass; minimal, mysterious, sparse production.
cc668fda-cd96-4aa3-8990-45814a0f037c.lyrics:
[Intro - whispered, low male voice]
Catch the king... catch the king...
王を捕らえろ... 왕을 잡아라...

[Verse - spoken]
A play within a play, watch his face
芝居の中の芝居
연극 속의 연극

[Instrumental build]

[Drop]

[Chant]
The mousetrap (mousetrap)
ねずみ取り (ねずみ取り)
쥐덫 (쥐덫)

[Instrumental break - rolling bass]

[Whispered]
The play, the play, catch the guilty
芝居だ、芝居だ
연극이다, 연극이다

[Chant]
The mousetrap (mousetrap)
ねずみ取り (ねずみ取り)
쥐덫 (쥐덫)

[Outro - fade]

4a786f42-f050-4cc7-9bcd-d0767c9db2d4.title: Ophelia's River オフィーリア 오필리아
4a786f42-f050-4cc7-9bcd-d0767c9db2d4.tags: Dark progressive trance, low male spoken and chanted vocals with whispered ad-libs between lines and stacked hook harmonies; driving 138 BPM four-on-the-floor pulse; rolling sub bass and sparse, minimal synth textures; dark, restrained production with a gradual build, focused drop, and fading outro.
4a786f42-f050-4cc7-9bcd-d0767c9db2d4.lyrics:
[Intro - whispered, low male voice]
Down to the river... down to the river...
川へ... 강으로...

[Verse - spoken]
Flowers in her hair, the water is calm
髪に花を、川は静か
머리에 꽃을, 강은 고요해

[Instrumental build]

[Drop]

[Chant]
Ophelia (Ophelia), river
オフィーリア (オフィーリア)
오필리아 (오필리아), 강물

[Instrumental break - rolling bass]

[Whispered]
Float and sink, float and sink
浮かんで沈む
떠오르고 가라앉네

[Chant]
Ophelia (Ophelia), river
オフィーリア (オフィーリア)
오필리아 (오필리아), 강물

[Outro - fade]

dcc8f710-ab06-4e00-8c8d-7fdefbd6107a.title: The Rest Is Silence 沈黙 침묵
dcc8f710-ab06-4e00-8c8d-7fdefbd6107a.tags: Dark progressive trance, low male spoken, chanted, and whispered vocals with clipped rhythmic staccato phrasing and doubled hooks; rolling sub bass, four-on-the-floor kick, sparse shadowed synth pulses; deep hypnotic 140 BPM drive; gradual cool-down slows the tempo as the beat fades.
dcc8f710-ab06-4e00-8c8d-7fdefbd6107a.lyrics:
[Intro - whispered, low male voice]
Silence... silence...
沈黙... 침묵...

[Verse - spoken]
Swords cross, poison waits, the crown falls
剣が交わる 毒が待つ
칼이 부딪히고 독이 기다려

[Instrumental build]

[Drop]

[Chant]
Silence (silence)
沈黙 (沈黙)
침묵 (침묵)

[Instrumental break - rolling bass]

[Whispered]
Fall, fall, the rest is quiet
倒れる、倒れる
쓰러진다, 쓰러진다

[Chant]
Silence (silence)
沈黙 (沈黙)
침묵 (침묵)

[Instrumental build]

[Drop]

[Outro - cool-down, slowing tempo, beat fades, whispered]
Silence... 沈黙... 침묵...
Sleep now... おやすみ... 잘 자...

d012d177-6d21-4177-b9f0-a690a67286ea.title: Bunburying
d012d177-6d21-4177-b9f0-a690a67286ea.tags: Late-1960s psychedelic Broadway rock musical, strong male lead in a low, dark register with half-spoken talk-sing and ensemble chorus; tape-saturated production; groovy bass, Hammond organ, fuzz guitar, horns and hand percussion; funky, energetic groove.
d012d177-6d21-4177-b9f0-a690a67286ea.lyrics:
[Intro - hand drums, fuzz guitar, horns]
[Verse 1 - Algernon]
Jack, my friend, you're looking guilty, what's the secret in your eyes?
Cecily in the country, Gwendolen in town, what a prize!
I've invented an invalid, poor Bunbury, so ill,
Every time a dull dinner calls, he's dying on the hill!

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Bunburying! Bunburying!
Let the sick friend do the lying!
Bunburying! Bunburying!
Two lives are better than one, we're flying!

[Verse 2 - Jack]
In the country I'm Jack, so serious and so sound,
In the city I'm Ernest, the wildest man in town!
A cigarette case with a secret inscription,
Now you want an explanation, what a fine description!

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Bunburying! Bunburying!
Let the sick friend do the lying!
Bunburying! Bunburying!
Two lives are better than one, we're flying!

[Bridge - spoken then sung]
Oh, the truth is rarely pure and never simple, my dear,
So pass the muffins, pour the tea, and let's all disappear!

[Instrumental - Hammond organ and fuzz guitar solo]

[Final Chorus - Ensemble]
Bunburying! Bunburying!
Everybody's got a double, singing!
Bunburying! Bunburying!
Hey hey hey, Bunburying!

f9074f80-ee2e-4a1c-b612-5a3bc4772703.title: A Handbag
f9074f80-ee2e-4a1c-b612-5a3bc4772703.tags: Late-1960s rock musical, spring-reverb fuzz guitar and Hammond organ with groovy bass, brass stabs, and hand percussion; strong male warm mid-range half-spoken talk-sing lead with ensemble chorus; energetic funky rock pulse.
f9074f80-ee2e-4a1c-b612-5a3bc4772703.lyrics:
[Intro - mock-stern bass groove, brass stabs]
[Verse 1 - Lady Bracknell, spoken-sung]
Sit up straight, young man, I have a little list,
Do you smoke? Good, a man should have a hobby, don't resist!
Your income, sir? Your address? Your family tree?
Who were your parents? Come on, answer me!

[Verse 2 - Jack]
I lost them both, ma'am, quite by accident, it's true,
I was found in a bag at Victoria Station, queue!
A black leather bag, with a handle, in the cloakroom, left behind...

[Chorus - Lady Bracknell and Ensemble]
A handbag?! A handbag?!
Born in a handbag?! Oh, the shame!
A handbag?! A handbag?!
Find some relations, or lose the name!

[Verse 3 - Lady Bracknell]
Return to society with a parent of some sort,
Either gentleman or lady, I don't mind, of any sort!
Gwendolen, we're leaving, tuck your dreams away,
We'll not marry into luggage on a Wednesday!

[Chorus - Lady Bracknell and Ensemble]
A handbag?! A handbag?!
Born in a handbag?! Oh, the shame!
A handbag?! A handbag?!
Find some relations, or lose the name!

[Bridge - Ensemble, whispered]
Hand... bag... hand... bag... (hmm, hmm, hmm)

[Instrumental - Hammond organ solo, fuzz guitar riff]

[Final Chorus - Everyone]
A handbag?! A handbag?!
Hey hey hey, a handbag!

715db9e3-2558-410d-9c76-17d81840f486.title: Cucumber Sandwiches
715db9e3-2558-410d-9c76-17d81840f486.tags: Late-1960s psychedelic rock musical, funky Broadway-style tribal rock groove; groovy bass, Hammond organ, fuzz guitar, horns and hand percussion, featured organ-and-guitar solos; spring-reverb guitar, warm mid-range strong male lead with powerful full-voice belts and ensemble chorus; energetic, propulsive pulse.
715db9e3-2558-410d-9c76-17d81840f486.lyrics:
[Intro - cucumber-crunch percussion, bouncy bass, horns]
[Verse 1 - Algernon]
Lane, my man, the sandwiches, where did they all go?
I ordered them for Lady Bracknell, and now it's just a show!
The cucumber, so crisp, so thin, on bread of butter white,
And somehow I have eaten them all by candlelight!

[Verse 2 - Lane]
Sir, there were no cucumbers at the market today,
Not even for ready money, so I'm sorry to say.
Champagne's very poor, sir, drunk in a single home,
Married households lack the finer vintages, I've known.

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Cucumber sandwiches! Cucumber sandwiches!
Thin and green and utterly delicious!
Cucumber sandwiches! Cucumber sandwiches!
Who's to blame? Not me, I'm suspicious!

[Verse 3 - Algernon]
Lane, you philosopher, a servant wise and dry,
You say that marriage is a muddle, and I can't tell you why!
Bring me the plate, the whole plate, and tell no one I'm pleased,
What the aunt can't see won't make her bleed!

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Cucumber sandwiches! Cucumber sandwiches!
Thin and green and utterly delicious!
Cucumber sandwiches! Cucumber sandwiches!
Who's to blame? Not me, I'm suspicious!

[Instrumental - Hammond organ and fuzz guitar solo]

[Final Chorus - Ensemble]
Cucumber sandwiches! Hey hey hey!
Pass the plate, we're gone away!

3a0759b2-2441-4473-85d8-a99f07c54b38.title: Gwendolen, I Must Propose
3a0759b2-2441-4473-85d8-a99f07c54b38.tags: Psychedelic rock, close-miked dry drums; groovy bass, Hammond organ, fuzz guitar, punchy horns, and hand percussion; energetic funky theatrical groove with ensemble choruses and featured Hammond organ and fuzz guitar solos; strong male lead in a dark lower register, full-voice belt, joined by a bold ensemble chorus.
3a0759b2-2441-4473-85d8-a99f07c54b38.lyrics:
[Intro - drum roll, warm organ swell, horns]
[Verse 1 - Jack]
Gwendolen, I must propose, I've practiced it all day,
Your name is music to my ears, in every possible way!
Ernest is the name, my love, the sweetest in the land,
I'd marry you tomorrow, here's my heart, here's my hand!

[Verse 2 - Gwendolen]
I'll be frank, dear Ernest, my ideal's been that name,
Since childhood I have dreamed of it, it's set my heart aflame!
But you didn't get down on your knees, that's how it's done,
Propose it properly, darling, and then we've just begun!

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Gwendolen, I must propose!
On bended knee, as everyone knows!
Gwendolen, I must propose!
Say yes, say yes, and off he goes!

[Verse 3 - Jack]
Down on my knees in the drawing room I go,
Hoping that your mother isn't coming in below!
I love you madly, I'd say it twice as loud,
Be my wife, my darling, make me proud!

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Gwendolen, I must propose!
On bended knee, as everyone knows!
Gwendolen, I must propose!
Say yes, say yes, and off he goes!

[Instrumental - Hammond organ and fuzz guitar solo]

[Final Chorus - Ensemble]
Gwendolen, I must propose! Hey hey hey!
Yes! Yes! Yes!

95afc1b6-c757-4dea-9178-8d84e05a3904.title: The Line Is Immaterial
95afc1b6-c757-4dea-9178-8d84e05a3904.tags: Psychedelic rock, energetic funky Broadway pulse; warm mid-range male lead with clipped staccato phrasing and ensemble choruses; close-miked rhythm section, groovy bass, Hammond organ, fuzz guitar, horns, hand percussion, and organ-to-guitar solo.
95afc1b6-c757-4dea-9178-8d84e05a3904.lyrics:
[Intro - stomping drums, brass stabs, fuzz guitar]
[Verse 1 - Lady Bracknell]
The line is immaterial, you may keep your brother's face,
But family is a fiction in a handbag, what disgrace!
Nobody who lacks relations can be wed to my dear girl,
Come, Gwendolen, we're leaving in a most dignified whirl!

[Verse 2 - Jack]
But my lady, I've a ward, a girl so sweet and true,
And an income that is handsome, what more can I do?
Gwendolen, I'll write to you, I'll send you every day,
Lady Bracknell, I beg you, don't take her away!

[Chorus - Lady Bracknell and Ensemble]
The line is immaterial! Immaterial!
Draw it, cross it, tie it with a bow!
The line is immaterial! Immaterial!
Pack your bags and out we go!

[Verse 3 - Gwendolen]
Mama, I'll write to him, my heart will not be tamed,
I'll love you, Ernest, always, whatever you are named!
Out the door in style, with a toss of my hat,
Society can say what it likes, that's that!

[Chorus - Lady Bracknell and Ensemble]
The line is immaterial! Immaterial!
Draw it, cross it, tie it with a bow!
The line is immaterial! Immaterial!
Pack your bags and out we go!

[Instrumental - Hammond organ and fuzz guitar solo]

[Final Chorus - Ensemble]
Immaterial! Hey hey hey!
Curtain falls on Act One today!
